CustomField.label: LTV
CustomField.description: Lending value is the lower of price and appraisal
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lending value is the lower of price and appraisal
CustomField.formula: IF(Purchase_Price__c > 0, Loan_Amount__c / IF(OR(ISBLANK(Appraised_Value__c), Appraised_Value__c = 0), Purchase_Price__c, MIN(Purchase_Price__c, Appraised_Value__c)), NULL)
